text: Alpha SA's consolidated revenue for 2025 amounted to €1,250 million, up 8% from 2024 (€1,157 million).
Alpha SA's adjusted EBITDA reached €275 million in 2025, a margin of 22% of revenue.
Alpha SA's net debt at 31 December 2025 stood at €550 million, compared with €610 million a year earlier.
The syndicated credit agreement includes a leverage covenant: the ratio of net debt to adjusted EBITDA must remain below 3.5x.
The board of directors proposes a dividend of €1.20 per share, payable in cash in June 2026. The share capital comprises 40 million shares.
Net income attributable to the group was €110 million, i.e. earnings per share of €2.75.
Capital expenditure (capex) for 2025 amounted to €95 million, of which €30 million was devoted to external growth.
The group's effective tax rate was 25% in 2025.
Interest rate risk: 70% of gross debt is at fixed rates. A 100 basis point increase in variable rates would increase financial expenses by €4 million.
Alpha's free cash flow came to €130 million in 2025.
Beta Holding reported revenue of €480 million in 2025, down 3%.
Beta Holding's EBITDA margin was 15% of revenue in 2025.
Beta Holding's net debt was €360 million at the end of 2025.
